# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment documents copied from the assessment facts engine output. Use the links below to navigate the available artifacts.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - High-level application layers and detailed component relationships.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - Declared package dependencies grouped by functional area.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - Controller endpoints, contracts, communication patterns, and request sequence.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Persistence model, identity entities, and data sensitivity summary.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, properties, profiles, and sensitive settings inventory.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Primary account-management workflows and mixed-authentication process flow.
